summary: Merging the Ark rework (video backdrops behind Converter, Squads and Artifacts) with bleeding-edge: the Pilots tab is kept exactly as you built it, but its grid now reads its own copy of the old list margins (PILOT_LIST_X/Y/H = 40, 176, 864) because Squads moved to the R67 board's row, and Pilots joins Decor in VEILED (it keeps its veil and sea: it has no room video behind it). ArkView.prefab was regenerated. A separate thread is drawing PDA-style mockups for the Pilots tab; nothing there is built yet.
